evidence: The HfxZr1−xO2 films were formed by ALD using three different precursor combinations: hafnium tetrachloride (HfCl4), zirconium tetrachloride (ZrCl4), and deuterated water (D2O) at 300°C (denoted as HfxZr1−xO2 A), tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)hafnium (TEMAHf), tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZr), and ozone (O3) at 275°C (denoted as HfxZr1−xO2 B), and TEMAHf, TEMAZr, and O2 plasma at 250°C (denoted as HfxZr1−xO2 C).
